UnauthenticatedResponse.description: Unauthenticated error response (HTTP 401). Returned as GatewayAuthError from Node gateway (kit5_operator_session missing/invalid), or ServiceAuthError from direct Go service JWT assertion failure.

GatewaySessionCookie.description: Kit 5 operator session cookie (kit5_operator_session). Established via POST /api/kit5/session with operator token, origin authorization, and 8-hour TTL (Set-Cookie: kit5_operator_session=...; Path=/api; HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=None; Max-Age=28800). Authenticated at Node gateway proxy before forwarding to Go service with actor context.
GatewaySessionCookie.name: kit5_operator_session

ServiceJWT.description: Internal service-to-service JWT assertion for direct Go service access (Issuer: flowcard-node-proxy, Audience: flowcard-onboarding-service).

info.description: Authoritative underwriting platform company onboarding and document management API. Business endpoints are auth-gated via kit5_operator_session cookie at the Node gateway proxy (or internal ServiceJWT assertion) and require database persistence. Application submission (/submit) is fail-closed blocked.
info.title: FlowCard Company Onboarding Operator API

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of companies wrapped in a pagination envelope with next_cursor. Supports status, limit, and cursor filters.

parameters.description: Maximum records to return (default 20, positive integer)
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Filter companies by lifecycle status (ACTIVE, ARCHIVED)
parameters.name: status

parameters.description: Opaque pagination cursor from previous response
parameters.name: cursor

post.description: Registers a new business entity with initial status ACTIVE and revision 1. Legal name is required (min 2, max 200 characters). Accepts optional business profile, registration identifiers, and people.

401.description: Missing or invalid operator session / JWT

delete.description: Permanently deletes a draft company with zero platform activity or historical submissions. Returns ActionResponse with code COMPANY_DELETED (not 204 No Content).

409.description: Company has historical submissions and cannot be deleted

get.description: Retrieves a single business entity by its opaque prefixed ID (e.g. comp_...).

patch.description: Applies partial updates to company fields. Requires expected_revision matching current revision for optimistic concurrency control (CAS). Correcting registration identifiers on companies with submitted application history requires explicit actor and reason.

requestBody.description: Partial company update fields and CAS expected_revision

400.description: Malformed JSON or domain invariant failure

put.description: PUT alias for PATCH /api/companies/{id}; preserves identical partial update and CAS revision semantics.

requestBody.description: Partial company update fields and CAS expected_revision

400.description: Malformed JSON or domain invariant failure

post.description: Transitions company status to ARCHIVED. Requires expected_revision matching current revision. Rejected with 409 Conflict if open onboarding applications exist.

requestBody.description: CAS expected_revision and optional archive reason

409.description: Revision conflict or company has open applications

get.description: Retrieves all platform accounts connected to the company. NOTE: Returns a raw JSON array of PlatformAccountResponse items (not wrapped in a pagination envelope).

200.description: Raw JSON array of platform accounts

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of onboarding applications. Supports filtering by company_id, platform, status, limit, and cursor.

parameters.description: Filter applications by company opaque identifier
parameters.name: company_id

parameters.description: Filter by application status (DRAFT, SUBMISSION_PENDING, UNDER_REVIEW, INFORMATION_REQUIRED, COMPLETED, REJECTED, CANCELLED)
parameters.name: status

post.description: Creates an onboarding application for a company and target platform. Fails with 409 Conflict if an active, non-terminal application already exists for the company and platform.

409.description: An active application already exists for this company and platform

get.description: Retrieves an onboarding application aggregate including embedded company snapshot, documents, and information requests.

patch.description: Updates platform-specific onboarding details (e.g. industry category, revenue estimates, person residential addresses). Requires expected_revision CAS.

requestBody.description: Updated platform details and CAS expected_revision

409.description: Revision conflict or application is not editable

post.description: Transitions an application to CANCELLED status prior to platform submission. Requires expected_revision matching current revision.

409.description: Revision conflict or application already submitted/terminal

get.description: Retrieves document metadata attached to an onboarding application. NOTE: Returns a raw JSON array of DocumentResponse items (not wrapped in an envelope).

200.description: Raw JSON array of document metadata

post.description: Uploads a document via multipart/form-data. Maximum size is 10 MiB. Content is sniffed for verified PDF, JPEG, or PNG magic bytes; client-declared MIME spoofing is rejected. Requires expected_revision matching current application revision.

file.description: Document binary stream (PDF, JPEG, or PNG, max 10 MiB)

person_id.description: Optional person ID reference for identity documents

requestBody.description: Multipart file and metadata form fields

400.description: Malformed multipart data or missing file

404.description: Application or referenced entity not found

409.description: Revision conflict or application is terminal

422.description: File exceeds 10 MiB, unsupported MIME, or spoofed content-type

get.description: Streams private decrypted document bytes directly to the client. Responses include Content-Disposition: attachment, sniffed Content-Type (application/pdf, image/jpeg, or image/png), and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.
Retrieves immutable historical submission records attached to this application. NOTE: Returns a raw JSON array of SubmissionResponse items (not wrapped in a pagination envelope).

post.description: Validates saved application data and atomically records a frozen initial Submission, idempotency response, and durable worker job. Platform submission runs asynchronously.

parameters.description: Unique key for this actor, application, and submit action. Reuse it unchanged to replay the original response.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

requestBody.description: Application revision expected by the operator

202.description: Submission queued for asynchronous processing; acceptance is not provider approval

409.description: Idempotency mismatch, in-progress submission, incompatible state, or revision conflict

422.description: Saved-data readiness or request validation failed

post.description: Validates saved application data for completeness and platform contract readiness. Returns HTTP 200 with code VALIDATION_PASSED when all gates pass. Returns HTTP 422 with the identical ValidationResult schema containing field errors when requirements are missing or unverified.

422.description: Verification failed with missing or invalid fields

get.description: Reads a connected platform account aggregate by ID (e.g. pa_...).
Reads an immutable frozen submission aggregate by ID (e.g. sub_...).
